note: views_rss_dc registers the Dublin Core Metadata Element Set as item elements via hook_views_rss_item_elements() under namespace 'dc' (URI http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/), module key 'views_rss_dc'. dc:date is reformatted to ISO-8601, unlike views_rss_core's RFC-822 pubDate/lastBuildDate. Medium cases target dc:date and dc:publisher; hard cases target dc:creator and dc:rights - all grounded in real Views config entities (vrss_dc_* machine names).

evals.prompt: What XML namespace prefix and URI does the views_rss_dc submodule declare for the Dublin Core elements it adds to an RSS feed?
evals.expected_output: views_rss_dc_views_rss_namespaces() declares the 'dc' namespace with URI http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/.

evals.prompt: How does views_rss_dc format the dc:date item element's value, and how does that differ from views_rss_core's pubDate/lastBuildDate elements?
evals.expected_output: views_rss_dc_preprocess_item_dc_date() reformats the value with date('c', strtotime(...)) - ISO-8601 - after first running it through views_rss_core's pubdate preprocessor to strip stray tags. views_rss_core's pubDate/lastBuildDate instead use views_rss_format_date(), which is RFC-822.

evals.prompt: Name at least five Dublin Core item elements the views_rss_dc submodule adds as configurable options in a View's Advanced RSS Feed row settings.
evals.expected_output: views_rss_dc_views_rss_item_elements() adds all 15: dc:title, dc:creator, dc:subject, dc:description, dc:publisher, dc:contributor, dc:date, dc:type, dc:format, dc:identifier, dc:source, dc:language, dc:relation, dc:coverage, dc:rights.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a View called vrss_dc_date with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin, mapping some field to the item <dc:date> element. Inspect its live configuration and report which field id is mapped to the dc:date element.

This Drupal site has a View called vrss_dc_publisher with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin, mapping some field to the item <dc:publisher> element. Inspect its live configuration and report which field id is mapped to the dc:publisher element.

On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_dc_creator with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin (views_rss_fields), mapping a field to the item <dc:creator> RSS element. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_dc_creator has a display whose display_options.row.type is views_rss_fields and display_options.row.options.item.dc.views_rss_dc.creator is a non-empty field id.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_dc_rights with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin (views_rss_fields), mapping a field to the item <dc:rights> RSS element. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_dc_rights has a display whose display_options.row.type is views_rss_fields and display_options.row.options.item.dc.views_rss_dc.rights is a non-empty field id.
